preprocessing_policy: Fit a separate TabularDataPreprocessor on each arm's permitted training composition (D_source_train + B_k). Guarantees that each model is self-contained with its own preprocessor, with zero evaluation snooping.
target_evaluation_protocol: Confirmatory, single-pass evaluation on D_target_eval (N=493) under the frozen TELCO_CONCEPT rule. No hyperparameter tuning, budget selection, seed searching, or iterative retry using target evaluation.
source_evaluation_protocol: Assess source-domain retention on D_source_eval (N=493) under original observational truth.
abstention_conditions: If adaptation budget is 0 or labels unverified -> ABSTAIN
If degradation delta on A0 is < 0.05 -> recovery fraction undefined
